sentences.en: We get support from UC Davis, a globally ranked university working to solve the world's most pressing problems in food, energy, health, education, and the environment.
sentences.zh: 我们获得了加州大学戴维斯分校的支持，这是一所全球知名的大学，致力于解决世界在食品、能源、健康、教育和环境方面最紧迫的问题。

sentences.en: UC Davis researchers collaborate and innovate in California and around the globe to find transformational solutions.
sentences.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校的研究人员在加州及全球各地合作创新，以寻找变革性的解决方案。

sentences.en: It's all part of the university's mission to promote quality of life for all living things.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是该大学促进所有生物生活质量的使命的一部分。

sentences.en: Find out more at 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu.
sentences.zh: 详情请访问 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu。

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是 99% Invisible。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国的

sentences.en: paper currency is so ubiquitous that to really look at its graphic design with fresh eyes requires deliberate and focused attention.
sentences.zh: 纸币是如此无处不在，以至于要用全新的视角去真正审视它的平面设计，需要刻意且专注的注意力。

sentences.en: So pull out a greenback from your wallet or look at a picture online if you're in another country and just really take it in.
sentences.zh: 所以，从钱包里掏出一张美钞，或者如果你在国外的话，看看网上的图片，然后好好端详一下。

sentences.en: All the fonts, the busy filigree, the micro patterns.
sentences.zh: 所有的字体、繁复的花边、微型图案。

sentences.en: It's just dreadful.
sentences.zh: 简直糟糕透顶。

sentences.en: From a pure designer's point of view, that's tough because it is a little bit subjective.
sentences.zh: 纯粹从设计师的角度来看，这很难评，因为这带有一定的主观性。

sentences.en: But it's horrible.
sentences.zh: 但它确实太糟糕了。

sentences.en: There's like eight fonts on this thing.
sentences.zh: 这上面大概有八种字体吧。

sentences.en: Typographically, graphically, symbolically.
sentences.zh: 从排版、图形到象征意义上来说都是如此。

sentences.en: If it had never been designed before and someone was to submit that as a solution, I think they would just sort of throw it out.
sentences.zh: 如果以前从来没有过这种设计，而有人把这当成方案交上来，我想他们大概只会直接把它扔掉吧。

sentences.en: And I don't want to get too critical at this point because there are actually pretty compelling and understandable reasons for its particular brand of horribleness.
sentences.zh: 我不想在此时过分苛求，因为它的这种丑陋其实有着相当引人注目且可以理解的原因。

sentences.en: But I think the primary tension embodied in the design of the greenback boils down to how my friend Tom Nelson at the blog Humans and Design puts it.
sentences.zh: 但我认为美钞设计中所体现的核心矛盾，正如我的朋友、Humans and Design 博客的汤姆·尼尔森（Tom Nelson）所说的那样。

sentences.en: When I handle American money, it feels like an artifact because it's so ornate and it has an old look to it.
sentences.zh: 当我经手美国货币时，它感觉就像一件文物，因为它是如此繁复，而且带着一种陈旧的外观。

sentences.en: Even though paper currency itself, just the idea of money is a massive, world-changing technology, the look and feel of U.S.
sentences.zh: 尽管纸币本身——仅仅是货币这个概念——是一项巨大的、改变世界的科技，但美国

sentences.en: paper money is very stagnant.
sentences.zh: 纸币的外观和质感却非常停滞不前。

sentences.en: It seems like a relic from when our country was founded.
sentences.zh: 它看起来就像是我们国家建国时的遗物。

sentences.en: Would you buy a car that would still look like the Model T Ford?
sentences.zh: 你会买一辆看起来仍然像福特T型车的汽车吗？

sentences.en: No, you buy the latest model of it.
sentences.zh: 不会，你会买它的最新型号。

sentences.en: Things evolve and change with time.
sentences.zh: 事物会随着时间不断演变和改变。

sentences.en: That's Richard Smith.
sentences.zh: 那是理查德·史密斯。

sentences.en: He runs a contest called the Dollar Redesign Project.
sentences.zh: 他发起了一项名为“美元重新设计项目”的比赛。

sentences.en: It's become a classic, like classics do, through time and through usage and through familiarity.
sentences.zh: 就像经典事物一样，它随着时间、使用和熟悉度而成为了经典。

sentences.en: So its awkwardness from a design point of view has kind of been superseded by its symbolicness.
sentences.zh: 因此，从设计的角度来看，它的笨拙在某种程度上已经被它的象征意义所取代。

sentences.en: So if you were to start from scratch and redesign U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你要从头开始重新设计美国

sentences.en: paper money, Smith says there are five major areas where we could improve.
sentences.zh: 纸币，史密斯说我们可以在五个主要方面进行改进。

sentences.en: Number one is color.
sentences.zh: 第一点是颜色。

sentences.en: The idea of using one color doesn't really tell you much other than that we like the color green.
sentences.zh: 使用单一颜色的想法，除了说明我们喜欢绿色之外，并没有传达出太多的信息。

sentences.en: Our largely monochromatic money kind of baffles me.
sentences.zh: 我们这种基本单色的货币实在让我有点费解。

sentences.en: We've introduced a purple five and some peachy hues, but there are a lot of colors and most countries use at least some of them.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了紫色的五美元和一些桃色调，但有很多颜色，而且大多数国家至少会使用其中的几种。

sentences.en: Number two is size.
sentences.zh: 第二点是尺寸。

sentences.en: Or why is the American currency all one size?
sentences.zh: 或者说，为什么美国的货币尺寸都是一样的？

sentences.en: There's always been a question mark in my head and just never really made sense practically and philosophically.
sentences.zh: 我脑海中一直有个问号，这在实际和哲学层面上都真的说不通。

sentences.en: Having variable-sized coins certainly helps us sort them.
sentences.zh: 拥有不同尺寸的硬币确实有助于我们对它们进行分类。

sentences.en: And you could use the same principle for bills, which leads us to point number three in Smith's manifesto.
sentences.zh: 你也可以对纸币使用同样的原则，这就引出了史密斯宣言中的第三点。

sentences.en: Functionality.
sentences.zh: 功能性。

sentences.en: Some functionality that enables people, if they can't see, to clearly distinguish on a very sort of fundamental level which note is which.
sentences.zh: 某种功能，能够让视障人士在非常基础的层面上清晰地区分哪张是哪张面值。

sentences.en: The fact that there's no easy way for the blind to use our currency goes beyond bad design and is actually immoral.
sentences.zh: 盲人无法便捷使用我们货币这一事实，已经超越了设计糟糕的范畴，实际上是不道德的。

sentences.en: Then the next fundamental thing I thought was composition.
sentences.zh: 接下来我认为最基础的一点是构图。

sentences.en: That's number four.
sentences.zh: 那是第四点。

sentences.en: Meaning like what is it made from?
sentences.zh: 意思就是它是用什么材料制成的？

sentences.en: This is a little sort of conceptual into like where this could go, but you know,
sentences.zh: 这在概念上有点探讨它可以走向何方，但是你知道的，

sentences.en: it just seems that a product designer could come in and sort of come up with something really interesting.
sentences.zh: 这似乎只是产品设计师可以介入并想出一些真正有趣东西的领域。

sentences.en: Recycled material with a smaller carbon footprint or more durable synthetics that last longer.
sentences.zh: 碳足迹更小的回收材料，或者是更耐用的合成材料。

sentences.en: And at the very heart of the Dollar Redesign Project is number five.
sentences.zh: 而美元重新设计项目的核心正是第五点。

sentences.en: Symbolism.
sentences.zh: 象征意义。

sentences.en: Who should go on the bills and why?
sentences.zh: 谁应该上纸币？为什么？

sentences.en: You know, why are the founding fathers the be-all and end-all of everything that is America?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，为什么国父们就是代表美国的一切的全部和终点？

sentences.en: And I think for me that's the, one of the biggest issues if we were to change anything.
sentences.zh: 我想对我来说，如果要改变什么的话，这是其中一个最大的问题。

sentences.en: I would say that was, that would be where I would start.
sentences.zh: 我会说那是，那将是我开始的地方。

sentences.en: It could be a platform to celebrate everything that is unique, special, different, that you didn't know about America.
sentences.zh: 它可以是一个平台，用来庆祝所有独特的、特殊的、不同的、你所不了解的美国元素。

sentences.en: And that's the suggestion that can get a British expat on his way to American citizenship like Richard Smith.
sentences.zh: 这个建议能够吸引一个正在迈向美国公民身份的英国侨民，比如理查德·史密斯。

sentences.en: Some colorful hate mail.
sentences.zh: 一些色彩丰富的谩骂信。

sentences.en: But it's an intriguing list nonetheless.
sentences.zh: 但无论如何，这是一个引人入胜的清单。

sentences.en: Even if you just view the five suggestions as a philosophical exercise to assess the current design for all of its strengths and faults.
sentences.zh: 即使你只是将这五个建议视为一种哲学练习，来评估当前设计的优势和缺点。

sentences.en: It's hard to imagine all those things being modified on U.S.
sentences.zh: 很难想象所有这些事情都会在美国

sentences.en: currency.
sentences.zh: 货币上得到修改。

sentences.en: But it's not hard to imagine each of them being implemented somewhere.
sentences.zh: 但并不难想象其中每一项都在某个地方得到了实施。

sentences.en: In fact, most of them are implemented everywhere.
sentences.zh: 事实上，它们大多数在各地都得到了实施。

sentences.en: Case in point, Australia.
sentences.zh: 典型的例子就是澳大利亚。

sentences.en: On the other side of the world, each and every one of these five issues have coincidentally been addressed.
sentences.zh: 在地球的另一端，这五个问题中的每一个都巧合地得到了解决。

sentences.en: Let me introduce a masterpiece of Australian design and technology.
sentences.zh: 请允许我介绍一件澳大利亚设计和技术的杰作。

sentences.en: Australia's new $5 plastic note.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚的新版 5元塑料钞票。

sentences.en: I'm really proud of our money.
sentences.zh: 我真的为我们的货币感到骄傲。

sentences.en: I have absolutely no idea why I'm so proud of it, but I really am.
sentences.zh: 我完全不知道自己为什么会这么骄傲，但我确实很骄傲。

sentences.en: That's Tristan Cook.
sentences.zh: 那是特里斯坦·库克。

sentences.en: And you're about to hear why he's so proud.
sentences.zh: 你即将听到他为什么会如此骄傲。

sentences.en: Tristan and Tom Nelson, who you heard from briefly at the top of the show, are user-centered designers.
sentences.zh: 特里斯坦和汤姆·尼尔森（你在节目开头简单听过他的声音）是已用户为中心的设计师。

sentences.en: And they run a blog that I'm a big fan of called Humans in Design.
sentences.zh: 他们经营着一个我很喜欢的博客，叫做 Humans in Design。

sentences.en: Tristan is Australian.
sentences.zh: 特里斯坦是澳大利亚人。

sentences.en: Tom is American.
sentences.zh: 汤姆是美国人。

sentences.en: But Tom went to school in Australia for a couple of years.
sentences.zh: 但汤姆在澳大利亚上过几年学。

sentences.en: And the money there made a big impression on him.
sentences.zh: 那里的货币给他留下了深刻的印象。

sentences.en: The money is plastic.
sentences.zh: 这种货币是塑料制的。

sentences.en: And they're all different sizes and they're colorful.
sentences.zh: 而且它们的尺寸各不相同，颜色也很丰富。

sentences.en: At first, these changes were disconcerting.
sentences.zh: 起初，这些变化让人感到不安。

sentences.en: It all just looked like toy money to me.
sentences.zh: 这一切对我来说看起来就像是玩具钞票。

sentences.en: But after Tom's initial shock, he began to appreciate all the different design characteristics of Australian currency.
sentences.zh: 但在汤姆经历了最初的震惊之后，他开始欣赏澳大利亚货币的所有不同设计特点。

sentences.en: First is the color.
sentences.zh: 首先是颜色。

sentences.en: $5 is sort of a lavender.
sentences.zh: 5元有点像薰衣草紫。

sentences.en: $10 is blue with a little bit of a green stripe in it.
sentences.zh: 10元是蓝色的，里面带有一条微小的绿色条纹。

sentences.en: When you look at the ways you can tell the differences between things, generally it's called coding.
sentences.zh: 当你审视区分事物的方法时，通常这被称为编码。

sentences.en: That's a very simple human factors term for it.
sentences.zh: 这是人机工程学中一个非常简单的术语。

sentences.en: And you code through things like size, shape, feel, and color.
sentences.zh: 你可以通过大小、形状、触感和颜色等事物来进行编码。

sentences.en: So, in Australian money, we have ours coded primarily by color.
sentences.zh: 所以，在澳大利亚货币中，我们的货币主要通过颜色进行编码。

sentences.en: Which, in some ways, is a better index because it doesn't require knowledge of who's on the bill.
sentences.zh: 从某些方面来说，这是一种更好的索引方式，因为它不需要你了解纸币上印的是谁。

sentences.en: It only requires recognition of a color.
sentences.zh: 它只需要你识别颜色。

sentences.en: Or an association with a pineapple or a lobster.
sentences.zh: 或者将其与菠萝或龙虾联系起来。

sentences.en: It's not very common just yet, but we call our notes colloquial names by their colors.
sentences.zh: 虽然现在还不是很普遍，但我们习惯用它们的颜色来给纸币起俗称。

sentences.en: And my two personal favorites are calling the $20 note, which is sort of an orange color, calling it a lobster.
sentences.zh: 我个人最喜欢的两个是把面值有点像橙色的 20元纸币叫做“龙虾”。

sentences.en: And calling the $50 note, which is sort of a green and yellow color, and calling it a piney, which is short for a pineapple.
sentences.zh: 以及把面值有点像绿黄相间的 50元纸币叫做“派尼”（piney），这是菠萝（pineapple）的简称。

sentences.en: It's all about the pineys.
sentences.zh: 这全都是关于“派尼”的。

sentences.en: Number two, size.
sentences.zh: 第二点，尺寸。

sentences.en: The bills are also different sizes as well, so they feel different in your hand.
sentences.zh: 这些纸币的大小也各不相同，所以它们在你手里的触感也不同。

sentences.en: Sometimes when I've got a bit of cash in my pocket, I can tell the difference between a $5 note and a $20 note because of the feel.
sentences.zh: 有时当我口袋里有一点现金时，我可以凭手感分辨出 5元纸币和 20元纸币的区别。

sentences.en: I would say that it's about a centimeter difference between each denomination, which between a 5 and a 10 isn't that big.
sentences.zh: 我想每种面值之间大约有一厘米的差距，这在 5元和 10元之间其实没那么大。

sentences.en: But between a 5 and a 50 is very big.
sentences.zh: 但在 5元和 50元之间就非常大了。

sentences.en: So, you get like four centimeters difference.
sentences.zh: 所以，你大约会有四厘米的差距。

sentences.en: Both number one and two relate to the third issue raised by Richard Smith, and that's functionality.
sentences.zh: 第一点和第二点都与理查德·史密斯提出的第三个问题有关，那就是功能性。

sentences.en: You can see whether you've got a 5, a 10, a 20, or a 50 from the top of your wallet.
sentences.zh: 你从钱包顶部就能看出自己拿的是 5元、10元、20元还是 50元。

sentences.en: Because of the color and size differences.
sentences.zh: 因为颜色和尺寸有所不同。

sentences.en: Number four, composition.
sentences.zh: 第四点，材质。

sentences.en: It's a thin sheet of plastic.
sentences.zh: 这是一张薄薄的塑料片。

sentences.en: The polymer notes were developed primarily to combat counterfeiting.
sentences.zh: 聚合物钞票的开发主要是为了打击伪造。

sentences.en: Feels like plastic that you can fold and scrunch up.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像可以折叠和揉皱的塑料。

sentences.en: You can actually put it through the washing machine and it'll be fine.
sentences.zh: 你甚至可以把它塞进洗衣机洗，也没问题。

sentences.en: If you drop a note on the floor of a men's room, you don't really feel bad about picking it up and putting it under the faucet before you put it back in your pocket.
sentences.zh: 如果你把一张钞票掉在男厕所的地板上，你捡起来把它放在水龙头下冲洗一下，然后再放回口袋里，心里并不会觉得有什么不舒服。

sentences.en: These plastic notes cost more, but they last longer.
sentences.zh: 这些塑料钞票成本更高，但它们更耐用。

sentences.en: They tend to last four times longer than fibrous paper notes.
sentences.zh: 它们的寿命通常是纤维纸币的四倍。

sentences.en: So, you get notes in Australia that are 20 years old and they pretty much just look the same.
sentences.zh: 所以在澳大利亚，你会发现有些钞票已经用了 20 年，但看起来几乎还是一模一样。

sentences.en: What Australia chooses to put on its currency is more in keeping with what Richard Smith of the Dollar Redesign Project would like to see.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚选择印在其货币上的内容，更加符合“美元重新设计项目”的理查德·史密斯所期望看到的样子。

sentences.en: It's much more inclusive than founding fathers and monuments.
sentences.zh: 它比国父们和纪念碑更具包容性。

sentences.en: But it's hard to tell if these symbols are conveying much of anything to everyday Australians.
sentences.zh: 但很难说这些象征意义是否向普通澳大利亚人传达了什么实质内容。

sentences.en: They don't put statesmen on money frequently.
sentences.zh: 他们不常把政治家印在货币上。

sentences.en: There are artists and poets and I think there are some Aboriginal leaders.
sentences.zh: 上面有艺术家、诗人，我想还有一些原住民领袖。

sentences.en: There's another thing too.
sentences.zh: 还有另一件事。

sentences.en: You could not put prime ministers on our money.
sentences.zh: 你们不能把总理印在我们的货币上。

sentences.en: We don't have the reverence for prime ministers in Australia.
sentences.zh: 我们在澳大利亚对总理没有那种敬意。

sentences.en: But most Australians couldn't name the people that are on their money.
sentences.zh: 但大多数澳大利亚人根本说不出他们货币上印的是谁。

sentences.en: I have absolutely no idea who is on any of our notes except for one side of the $5 note is the Queen.
sentences.zh: 我完全不知道我们任何一张钞票上印的是谁，除了 5元钞票的一面印着女王。

sentences.en: And that's just because I don't want her on there.
sentences.zh: 那只是因为我不想让她上钞票。

sentences.en: Yeah, I'd imagine if you asked any Australian if they know who is on their notes, there would be less than 1% of people who could name anybody other than the Queen.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想如果你问任何一个澳大利亚人是否知道他们的钞票上印的是谁，能够说出女王以外任何人的名字的人连 1% 都不到。

sentences.en: The symbolism in Australian cash seems to be tied more to the innovation of the bills themselves.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚现金中的象征意义似乎更多地与钞票本身的创新联系在一起。

sentences.en: There's a certain pride that polymer bills were developed in Australia and have been exported to the rest of the world.
sentences.zh: 人们有一种自豪感，即聚合物钞票是在澳大利亚开发的，并已出口到世界其他地方。

sentences.en: Australia now manufactures the polymer notes of nearly 20 other countries.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚现在为近 20 个其他国家制造聚合物钞票。

sentences.en: It's a good business for them.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说这是一门好生意。

sentences.en: The good design of the currency itself is the overriding brand.
sentences.zh: 货币本身优秀的设计才是最重要的品牌。

sentences.en: It's no ordinary note, however.
sentences.zh: 然而，这不是一张普通的钞票。

sentences.en: It's Australia's new polymer $10 note.
sentences.zh: 这是澳大利亚的新版聚合物 10元钞票。

sentences.en: And it was developed and printed right here.
sentences.zh: 它正是在这里开发和印刷的。

sentences.en: I would like to see American currency redesigned and treated more like a living piece of technology rather than an artifact.
sentences.zh: 我希望看到美国货币被重新设计，并被当作一件活生生的科技品来对待，而不是一件文物。

sentences.en: I think even the most jingoistic among us could concede that there are design innovations that could be incorporated into U.S.
sentences.zh: 我认为即使是我们当中最具沙文主义的人也不得不承认，确实有一些设计创新可以融入到美国

sentences.en: currency to make it better.
sentences.zh: 货币中，使其变得更好。

sentences.en: But there are some interesting reasons why we probably won't.
sentences.zh: 但有一些有趣的原因表明我们可能不会这么做。

sentences.en: You know, someone once told me that getting rid of the greenback would be like burning the flag on the steps of the Capitol.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，曾经有人对我说，摆脱绿钞就像在国会山台阶上焚烧国旗一样。

sentences.en: That's David Woolman.
sentences.zh: 那是大卫·伍尔曼。

sentences.en: My name is David Woolman.
sentences.zh: 我叫大卫·伍尔曼。

sentences.en: My book is The End of Money.
sentences.zh: 我的书是《金钱的终结》。

sentences.en: For a lot of people, our currency is a physical touchstone of our national identity.
sentences.zh: 对很多人来说，我们的货币是我们国家认同的实体试金石。

sentences.en: Some of this is emotional, but there is this other concern that is simultaneously tantalizing and scary, I think.
sentences.zh: 其中一部分是情感上的，但我认为还有另一个既诱人又令人害怕的担忧。

sentences.en: And that other concern is that when you redesign the money, you remind people what currency is and what gives the currency value.
sentences.zh: 另一个担忧是，当你重新设计货币时，你会提醒人们货币究竟是什么，以及是什么赋予了货币价值。

sentences.en: And of course, what gives the currency value is our belief that it's valuable.
sentences.zh: 当然，赋予货币价值的是我们相信它是有价值的。

sentences.en: And in the religious sense of it, nothing more than faith or trust or worship, whatever you want to call it,
sentences.zh: 从宗教的意义上来说，除了信念、信任或崇拜，无论你想怎么称呼它，

sentences.en: makes a dollar worth a dollar or worth whatever you're going to buy with it.
sentences.zh: 没有什么能让一美元真正价值一美元，或者价值你用它买得到的任何东西。

sentences.en: So that is upsetting to a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 所以这让很多人感到不安。

sentences.en: And to maintain the aura of strength and stability of the United States economy.
sentences.zh: 为了维护美国经济强大和稳定的光环。

sentences.en: It probably helps to maintain these legacy features in the design of our money.
sentences.zh: 在我们的货币设计中保留这些传统特征可能有所帮助。

sentences.en: Through what is now three or four generations, we've had the same color, I think, since the Civil War.
sentences.zh: 经过现在三四代人的时间，我想，自南北战争以来我们的颜色就一直没变。

sentences.en: The portraits, the engraved styling, the filigree, the legacy features convey stability.
sentences.zh: 肖像、雕刻风格、花丝以及传统特征传递着稳定。

sentences.en: And our currency, the currency on which all other currencies are hitched, has to be stable.
sentences.zh: 而我们的货币，即所有其他货币与之挂钩的货币，必须是稳定的。

sentences.en: So not only do we not redesign the stuff, but we don't pull older notes from circulation either.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们不仅不重新设计这些钞票，而且也不从流通中回收旧钞票。

sentences.en: So we'll have reissues and redesigns of our cash.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们的现金会进行再发行和重新设计。

sentences.en: But you can still use the last generation design as legal tender.
sentences.zh: 但你仍然可以使用上一代设计的法定货币。

sentences.en: In other countries, a complete redesign deprecates the old design.
sentences.zh: 在其他国家，彻底的重新设计会废除旧设计。

sentences.en: You're given a grace period to use or exchange it.
sentences.zh: 会给你一段宽限期去使用或兑换它。

sentences.en: But after a certain date, the old currency is shredded by the central bank and you can no longer spend any that you have left.
sentences.zh: 但在某个日期之后，旧货币会被中央银行粉碎，你剩下的旧币将无法再使用。

sentences.en: This has never been the case in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这在美国从未发生过。

sentences.en: You could even use an 18th century coin stamped with just the value of two cents to go buy something.
sentences.zh: 你甚至可以用一枚只标有两分钱面值的18世纪硬币去买东西。

sentences.en: You might want to be careful because that could be so stupid.
sentences.zh: 你可能得小心点，因为那样做可能太蠢了。

sentences.en: It could be worth, you know, $3,000 to a collector out there.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，它对收藏家来说可能价值3000美元。

sentences.en: But if you want to go spend it as two cents, you can.
sentences.zh: 但如果你想把它当两分钱花掉，也可以。

sentences.en: And again, this is part of creating this aura of super stability and inherent value of Federal Reserve notes.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，这也是营造美联储纸币超级稳定和内在价值光环的一部分。

sentences.en: David Woolman is quick to point out that even though these concerns of instability have been cited when people bring up redesigning the money or eliminating the penny,
sentences.zh: 大卫·沃尔曼（David Woolman）迅速指出，尽管人们在提出重新设计货币或取消一分硬币时，经常提到这些不稳定因素的担忧，

sentences.en: he thinks it's pretty irrational and an overly cautious stance.
sentences.zh: 但他认为这相当不理性，是一种过于谨慎的立场。

sentences.en: It seems to me a little bit patronizing to think that Americans couldn't handle a dollar redesign.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，认为美国人无法接受美元重新设计有点居高临下。

sentences.en: But really, who is going to push it forward?
sentences.zh: 但说实话，谁会去推动这件事呢？

sentences.en: You know, if you're going to go to work in government,
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你要在政府工作，

sentences.en: don't you almost by definition have some of that sense of patriotism and nationalism that would make you a little bit more inclined to like the greenback as is
sentences.zh: 难道你几乎生来就自带某种爱国主义和民族主义情结，使你更倾向于喜欢原样保持的美钞，

sentences.en: and a little less inclined to, you know, let some RISD hotshots get after it?
sentences.zh: 而不太愿意让罗德岛设计学院（RISD）的那些精英来插手吗？

sentences.en: But still, primarily driven by anti-counterfeiting measures, U.S.
sentences.zh: 不过，主要受防伪措施的推动，美国

sentences.en: currency has been pushed to change in recent years.
sentences.zh: 近年来货币一直在被迫改变。

sentences.en: And most of these new designs are why it looks worse than ever.
sentences.zh: 而这些新设计大多正是它看起来比以往更糟糕的原因。

sentences.en: The legacy features remain largely intact, but a layer of modern fonts and swirls makes the bills look like they're busting at the seaMs.
sentences.zh: 传统特征基本完好无损，但一层现代字体和漩涡图案让钞票看起来快要撑破了。

sentences.en: It's the worst of both worlds.
sentences.zh: 这是最糟糕的结合。

sentences.en: You know, it's absolute chaos.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这简直是一团糟。

sentences.en: There's very little that's elegant about our money from a design standpoint, as far as I understand it.
sentences.zh: 据我理解，从设计的角度来看，我们的货币几乎没有什么优雅可言。

sentences.en: But when I told David Wollman about my newfound discovery and appreciation of the Australian dollar as evangelized by Tristan and Tom, he was less than impressed.
sentences.zh: 但当我把对澳大利亚元的新发现和欣赏（正如特里斯坦和汤姆所宣扬的那样）告诉大卫·沃尔曼时，他却不以为然。

sentences.en: I don't think it's that remarkable.
sentences.zh: 我不觉得这有什么了不起的。

sentences.en: Congratulations to the Aussies and the scientists who came up with polymer banknotes.
sentences.zh: 祝贺澳大利亚人和发明聚合物钞票的科学家们。

sentences.en: And I think they profited well because of that innovation.
sentences.zh: 我想他们也因为这项创新获利颇丰。

sentences.en: But I'm just not convinced it's a very world-changing kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 但我只是不相信这是一件能改变世界的事情。

sentences.en: It's pretty.
sentences.zh: 它很好看。

sentences.en: Hey, I personally think pretty counts.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我个人认为好看很重要。

sentences.en: But from his point of view, a better-designed banknote, even a plastic one, is still just a piece of paper.
sentences.zh: 但在他看来，设计得更好的纸币，哪怕是塑料纸币，也依然只是一张纸。

sentences.en: I mean, his book is called The End of Money, after all.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，他的书就叫做《金钱的终结》。

sentences.en: The design efforts out there related to money that excite me more are the design for the user interface of apps for mobile money, right?
sentences.zh: 那些与货币相关的设计工作，比方说移动货币应用的界面设计，才更能让我兴奋，对吧？

sentences.en: How are we going to be transacting with money in PayPal, mobile, and Google Wallet?
sentences.zh: 我们将如何在 PayPal、手机和 Google Wallet 中使用货币进行交易？

sentences.en: And what are designers bringing to bear on those interfaces?
sentences.zh: 设计师们又为这些界面带来了什么？

sentences.en: Because the interface with paper or polymer money, I get it already.
sentences.zh: 因为对于纸质或聚合物货币的界面，我早就懂了。

sentences.en: And the truly interesting frontier of design is not going to be the banknote art that the Swiss come up with in 2016, right?
sentences.zh: 而真正有趣的设计前沿，将不是瑞士人在2016年设计出的钞票艺术，对吧？

sentences.en: It's going to be the interface with mobile apps and what designers are doing to make our interactions with money more fluid, more sophisticated, and possibly, God forbid, even,
sentences.zh: 它将是移动应用程序的界面，以及设计师们为了让我们的货币互动更加流畅、更加复杂，甚至，老天保佑，变得更

sentences.en: like, wiser.
sentences.zh: 加明智而正在做的事情。

sentences.en: You know, who's designing the apps to make us a little more careful with our money?
sentences.zh: 你知道，是谁在设计那些让我们对钱更加谨慎的应用程序？

sentences.en: And how are they bringing to bear sort of the principles of design to make that happen?
sentences.zh: 他们又是如何运用设计原则来实现这一点的？

sentences.en: And this is something that Tristan and Tom are totally on board with.
sentences.zh: 而这正是特里斯坦和汤姆完全赞同的观点。

sentences.en: Physical money is probably on its way out, and polymer money, as cool as it is, is a technology of its time.
sentences.zh: 实体货币可能正在走向消亡，而聚合物货币尽管很酷，但也只是特定时代的产物。

sentences.en: They themselves have actually designed clever user interfaces so that the good aspects of physical money are retained,
sentences.zh: 他们自己实际上也设计过巧妙的用户界面，从而保留了实体货币的优点，

sentences.en: and transactions feel more tangible and more real, even when it's just bits flying through the air.
sentences.zh: 并且让交易感觉更加切实、更加真实，即使那只是在空中飞舞的数据比特。

sentences.en: So the physical U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以实体的美国

sentences.en: $20 bill will probably be gone from widespread use before it's a lovely shade of orangey-red.
sentences.zh: 20美元面额纸币在它变成可爱的橙红色之前，大概就会从广泛使用中消失了。

sentences.en: I'm okay with that.
sentences.zh: 我对此没有意见。

sentences.en: Just as long as I don't have to see that wavy Six Flags Amusement Park font that says 20 USA in the background.
sentences.zh: 只要我不用看到背景里那个写着“20 USA”、带有波浪纹的六旗游乐园字体就行。

sentences.en: I mean, seriously, what the hell were they thinking?
sentences.zh: 我是说，说真的，他们脑子里到底在想什么？

sentences.en: That font is even cruel to Andrew Jackson.
sentences.zh: 这种字体对安德鲁·杰克逊（Andrew Jackson）来说甚至可以说是残酷的。

sentences.en: And that guy was a jerk.
sentences.zh: 而那家伙是个混蛋。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by me, Roman Mars,
sentences.zh: 本周的《99%隐形》由我罗曼·马尔斯（Roman Mars）制作，

sentences.en: with special thanks to Tristan Cook and Tom Nelson of the blog Humans in Design.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢博客“设计中的人类”（Humans in Design）的特里斯坦·库克（Tristan Cook）和汤姆·纳尔逊（Tom Nelson）。

sentences.en: We'll have a link on the website.
sentences.zh: 我们会在网站上提供链接。

sentences.en: We are a project of KALW 91.7 Local Public Radio in San Francisco
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山 KALW 91.7 地方公共广播电台

sentences.en: and the American Institute of Architects in San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 以及旧金山美国建筑师学会的一个项目。

sentences.en: Support for 99% Invisible is provided in part by tiny letter.
sentences.zh: 对《99%隐形》的支持部分由 tiny letter 提供。

sentences.en: Email for people with something to say.
sentences.zh: 为有话要说的人提供的电子邮件服务。

sentences.en: My boy Maslow always has something to say.
sentences.zh: 我的好兄弟马斯洛（Maslow）总是有话要说。

sentences.en: What do you have to say, Maslow?
sentences.zh: 你要说些什么，马斯洛？

sentences.en: My favorite thing to talk about is robots in Iron Man suits and stuff.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢谈论的是穿着钢铁侠战衣的机器人之类的事物。

sentences.en: Robots in Iron Man suits.
sentences.zh: 穿着钢铁侠战衣的机器人。

sentences.en: I would subscribe to that newsletter.
sentences.zh: 我会订阅那个时事通讯的。

sentences.en: It's free, easy, minimal, powerful, the simplest way to write an email newsletter.
sentences.zh: 它是免费的、简单的、极简的、强大的，是编写电子邮件时事通讯最简单的方式。

sentences.en: Online at tinyletter.com.
sentences.zh: 网址是 tinyletter.com。

sentences.en: We are distributed by PRX, the public radio exchange making public radio more public.
sentences.zh: 我们由 PRX 发行，这是一个让公共广播更加公共化的公共广播交流平台。

sentences.en: More at prx.org.
sentences.zh: 更多信息请访问 prx.org。

sentences.en: This is just a reminder that every episode of 99% Invisible is available to be downloaded for your listening pleasure.
sentences.zh: 这只是一个提醒，《99%隐形》的每一期节目都可以下载，供您收听欣赏。

sentences.en: And each one is better than the last, whether you're going backwards or forwards.
sentences.zh: 而且每一期都比前一期更好，无论你是往前听还是往后听。

sentences.en: It is amazing and impossible, but yet it is still true.
sentences.zh: 这既神奇又不可能，但它依然是真的。

sentences.en: You can find the show and like the show and interact with me on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在 Facebook 上找到这个节目、给节目点赞并与我互动。

sentences.en: I tweet and often tweet back to people at Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我发推特，并且经常在 @Roman Mars 上回复大家。

sentences.en: But this week, you will find pretty pictures of plastic bills at 99percentinvisible.org.
sentences.zh: 但本周，你可以在 99percentinvisible.org 上找到塑料钞票的精美图片。
